name: Grade 6 T1 Summative: Core Vocabulary
description: Ten core first-trimester words for the Grade 6 summative vocabulary table.

words.definition: A worldwide system that lets computers and people share information.
words.example: Students used the internet to open the school website and send a class message.

words.definition: A place online with pages of information.
words.example: The class opened a recycling website and identified its title, menu, and images.

words.definition: An app used to open websites.
words.example: The student used a browser to open the class web page.

words.definition: A name or number that helps find a place online.
words.example: Typing the website address sent the browser to the correct page.

words.definition: The readable name of a website.
words.example: In www.example.com, example.com is the readable domain name.

words.definition: A system that helps match a website name to its online address.
words.example: DNS matched the domain name to the website server address.

words.definition: A number address used by computers on a network.
words.example: The browser used an IP address to find the computer hosting the website.

words.definition: A small part of a message sent online.
words.example: A packet carried one part of the class message online.

words.definition: Information sent from one person or place to another.
words.example: The student wrote a message asking the group to check the shared file.

words.definition: A group of connected devices that can share information.
words.example: The school network let the classroom computers share the same printer.
